<!--
The title of this pull request becomes the subject line on main, because merges
are squashed with squash_merge_commit_title=PR_TITLE. It must therefore follow
Conventional Commits, and its type decides the next version release-please cuts.

This body becomes the commit body for the same reason
(squash_merge_commit_message=PR_BODY). Comments like this one are not included.
-->

## What changed

<!-- One paragraph. Say what the change does, not how it is implemented. -->

## Why

<!--
The reason the change is needed. For a bug fix, describe the failure: what
input, what wrong result. A reviewer who disagrees with the reason will
disagree with the change.
-->

## How it was verified

<!--
What you ran and what it reported, not what you expect it to do. A new or
changed check needs both a valid input that passes and a deliberately invalid
one that fails for the expected reason; state both.
-->

## Notes for the reviewer

<!--
Optional. Trade-offs you considered, alternatives you rejected, parts you are
unsure about, and anything deliberately left out of scope.
